membership.module.name: Membership
membership.module.description: Membership schemes, who holds them and until when, the members' area a members' scheme opens, and the lists a scheme checks against.
membership.settings.applications.expire-: How long an application may wait on the applicant before it expires. It never expires while it is waiting on the theatre.
membership.settings.renewal.opens-before: What a new scheme's renewal window starts as. Each scheme can change its own.
membership.settings.renewal.grace.label: Grace after the end
membership.settings.renewal.grace.help: What a new scheme's grace starts as: how long a membership still counts after its end date. Each scheme can change its own.
membership.settings.reminders.first.labe: First renewal reminder, before the end
membership.settings.reminders.first.help: How long before a membership ends its holder is first reminded to renew.
membership.settings.reminders.final.labe: Last renewal reminder, before the end
membership.settings.reminders.final.help: How long before a membership ends its holder is reminded for the last time. Must be shorter than the first.
membership.settings.reminders.after-laps: Tell a holder once their membership has ended
Sends one message when a membership has lapsed and was not renewed.
membership.settings.numbers.prefix.label: Before a member number
membership.settings.numbers.prefix.help: Shown in front of every member number, such as M-. Leave it empty to show the number alone.
Show open schemes to visitors who are not signed in
When off, only signed-in people see which memberships the theatre offers.
membership.settings.card.show.label: Offer a membership card
membership.settings.card.show.help: Whether Membership in My account offers a full-screen card the holder can show.
membership.settings.voting.qualifying-pe: How long somebody must have been a member of a voting scheme before they count as a voting member.
membership.settings.verification.member-: Turn off for a while, such as before the members list is uploaded, to give the member price to anyone signed in or typing a reference, without checking it. Tickets sold meanwhile still pass at the door after it is turned back on.
membership.settings.verification.list-ke: Keep an uploaded list for at most
The longest the entries of an uploaded list are kept. Shortening it removes entries at the next sweep, which changes who is verified and who gets a member price by reference.
membership.settings.verification.names-k: Keep names from a list after the entry ends
How long the name on an uploaded list is kept after that entry's end date, so staff can still compare it with the person in front of them.
membership.settings.retention.ended-afte: When an ended or lapsed membership loses the details of who held it. The counts of members stay.
membership.settings.ending.by-holder.lab: Holders may end their own membership
membership.settings.ending.by-holder.hel: What a new scheme starts as. Turn it off where another body, such as a students' union, owns the membership.
membership.settings.help.link.label: Where to send someone whose membership is not found
membership.settings.help.link.help: A page on this site, a web address or an email address. Used in "Have a membership? Contact us". Leave it empty to show the sentence without a link.
membership.settings.rules.reminders-in-o: The last renewal reminder must come after the first, so it must be a shorter time before the end.
membership.abilities.scheme.view.label: See membership schemes, including drafts and closed ones
membership.abilities.scheme.manage.label: Create, change, open, close and archive membership schemes
membership.abilities.membership.view.lab: See who holds which membership, with dates and status
membership.abilities.membership.fields.l: Fill in the details kept about a member
membership.abilities.membership.verify.l: Pass or decline an application waiting to be checked
membership.abilities.membership.import.l: Import members into a scheme from a file
membership.abilities.card.check.label: Check whether somebody else holds a membership, at the desk or the door
membership.abilities.verification-list.c: See the name behind a ticket bought with a membership reference
membership.abilities.verification-list.m: Load, add to and remove from verification lists, such as a students' union's list of student IDs
membership.notices.renewal-open.title: You can renew {scheme}
membership.notices.renewal-open.descript: Renew now and the new membership starts the day after this one ends.
membership.facts.holder.label: Holds a current membership
membership.facts.supporter.label: Is a supporter
membership.facts.voter.label: May vote: a member of a voting scheme past the qualifying period
membership.facts.scheme-holder.label: Holds a membership of this scheme
membership.welcome.gives: Your account shows what your membership includes.
